pois.label: 打印头（螺杆挤出总成）
pois.detail: 整机真正的核心执行器：伺服电机经行星减速器驱动螺杆，把干 regolith 粉料压实成条从喷嘴挤出，紧随喷嘴的 2.45 GHz 微波施加器就地把料条烧结成型。头上带缓存料斗（料位计）、料腔压力传感器、微波施加器与温度传感器——挤出量必须与龙门行走速度实时闭环：走快断条，走慢堆料。
pois.detail_en: The machine's real working actuator: a servo motor drives a screw through a planetary reducer, compacting dry regolith powder into a bead and pushing it out of the nozzle, while a 2.45 GHz microwave applicator trailing the nozzle sinters that bead in place. The head carries a buffer hopper with a level sensor, a barrel pressure sensor, and the applicator with its own thermocouple. Extrusion has to stay in closed loop with gantry travel speed: too fast and the bead breaks, too slow and it piles up.

specs.流量控制: 螺杆转速前馈 + 料腔压力反馈 + 微波功率随行速联动

specs_en.Flow control: screw-speed feedforward + barrel-pressure feedback + microwave power slaved to travel

pois.sim: 流量账本（受能量约束，非几何约束）：可用 30 kWe ÷ 0.40 kWh/kg = 作业期 75 kg/h ≈ 34 L/h；以 160×200 mm 断面反推，打印行速只有 ≈0.30 mm/s——0.25 m/s 是空行程速度，不是打印速度。启停段以螺杆短暂反转（回抽）消除滴料。
pois.sim_en: Flow ledger, set by energy rather than geometry: the available 30 kWe / 0.40 kWh/kg gives 75 kg/h while working, about 34 L/h. Against a 160 x 200 mm bead that reverse-solves to a printing speed of only 0.30 mm/s - the 0.25 m/s figure is rapid traverse, not printing. At starts and stops the screw briefly reverses to retract and stop the nozzle drooling.
pois.physics: 微波烧结而非熔融：螺杆先把干粉压实（无水、无粘结剂），微波对富铁 regolith 是体加热——2.45 GHz 从料条内部把颗粒接触点加热到原子扩散长出烧结颈，冷却即得强度。省掉整包熔化潜热（~0.4 MJ/kg，约占能量预算三成）是这条路线能塞进 30 kWe 的关键；激光/聚光只加热表层，稀薄大气又无对流帮忙铺热。
pois.physics_en: Microwave sintering, not melting: the screw first compacts dry powder - no water, no binder - and the microwave heats iron-rich regolith volumetrically. At 2.45 GHz the energy enters from inside the bead, driving atoms across grain contacts into sintering necks, and strength arrives on cooling. Skipping the latent heat of fusion (about 0.4 MJ/kg, near a third of the energy budget) is what lets this route fit inside 30 kWe, whereas a laser or concentrated sunlight heats only a surface and the thin atmosphere will not spread that heat by convection.

pois.label: 打印穹顶（半成，6 m）
pois.detail: 微波烧结 regolith 穹顶居住舱，螺旋连续路径逐层打印，层脊清晰可见。当前打印至 6.0 m（设计 7.5 m），顶口开口 6 m，最后数层转短弧螺旋收口形成台阶状未完成边缘。
pois.detail_en: A microwave-sintered regolith habitat dome printed layer by layer along one continuous spiral path, the layer ridges clearly visible. It currently stands at 6.0 m of a designed 7.5 m, with a 6 m opening at the top; the last few layers switch to short-arc spirals, leaving the stepped, unfinished edge.
sim: 层生产账：单层周长 19~31 m（随高度收缩），单层用料 1.3~2.2 t；按日间 600 kg/sol 的产能即 2~4 sol 打一层，已建的 37 层约 100 sol，整壳 ~120 t 正好对应一个建造季 ~200 sol。
悬挑校核：中部（h=4 m）单层径向内收 67 mm、层间搭接 66%——安全；顶口（h=6 m）母线倾角 42°，单层内收 142 mm、搭接仅 29%，已到悬挑极限——因此顶部转短弧螺旋收口，剩余开口待吊装预制顶盖封口。
sim_en: Layer production: each layer runs 19-31 m of circumference (shrinking with height) and consumes 1.3-2.2 t. At the 600 kg/sol daylight output that is 2-4 sol per layer, so the 37 layers already standing took about 100 sol, and the full ~120 t shell fills one construction season of about 200 sol.

Corbel check: at mid-height (h = 4 m) each layer steps 67 mm inward with 66% overlap - safe. At the top opening (h = 6 m) the meridian tilts 42 deg, each layer steps 142 mm inward and overlap falls to 29%, the corbelling limit. Hence the short-arc spiral close-out, with the remaining opening to be capped by a prefabricated lid.
pois.physics: 逐层堆叠的判据本是绿色强度 σ_y > ρ·g_mars·Δh×安全系数：新层要在下一层到来前扛住增量自重。但在 2~4 sol 一层的节奏下，下层早已冷透成岩——绿色强度根本不构成约束，真正的限制回到纯几何的悬挑搭接率。火星 0.38g 又把自重项打了 62% 折，同样的料在火星能打的悬挑角比地球大。
pois.physics_en: The stacking criterion is normally green strength: sigma_y > rho x g_mars x delta_h with a safety factor, each new layer carrying the added weight before the next arrives. At 2-4 sol per layer, though, the course below has long since cooled to stone - green strength never binds, and the real limit falls back to pure corbelling geometry. Mars gravity at 0.38 g then discounts the self-weight term by 62%, so the same material corbels at a steeper angle here than on Earth.

pois.label: 龙门桁架（12 m 跨）
pois.detail: 两座 A 字腿塔架骑在带枕木的地面重轨上构成移动门架：X 轴＝打印头小车沿横梁走行，Y 轴＝整门架沿轨道走行，Z 轴＝打印头沿立柱滑轨升降。伺服电机+齿轮齿条驱动，梁顶电缆桥架内拖链随动，塔顶红色警示灯。
pois.detail_en: Two A-frame leg towers ride heavy rail on sleepers to form a travelling portal: X is the print-head carriage along the beam, Y is the whole portal along the rails, Z is the head on the column slideways. Servo motors with rack and pinion drive all axes, cable chains follow inside the beam-top tray, and red warning beacons sit on the tower tops.

specs.驱动: 伺服 + 齿轮齿条（4 台走行 + 1 台小车 + 1 台升降）

specs_en.Drives: servo + rack and pinion (4 travel + 1 carriage + 1 hoist)

pois.sim: 横梁刚度账：0.8×1.0 m 箱形梁（壁 8 mm，I≈4.4×10⁻³ m⁴），打印头满载 800 kg 在火星重力下集中载荷 ≈3 kN，中点挠度 0.12 mm；叠加梁自重 0.26 mm，合计 ≈0.4 mm ≪ L/1000（12 mm）。
pois.sim_en: Beam stiffness: a 0.8 x 1.0 m box section (8 mm wall, I = 4.4e-3 m4) under a fully loaded 800 kg head is a 3 kN point load in Mars gravity, giving 0.12 mm mid-span deflection; with beam self-weight 0.26 mm, the total is about 0.4 mm, far inside L/1000 (12 mm).
pois.physics: 低重力红利与热变形主导：同截面梁在火星承载自重仅为地球 38%，刚度裕度天然放大 2.6 倍；真正吃掉精度预算的是昼夜 ΔT≈80 K 的热胀缩——12 m 钢梁伸缩 α·L·ΔT ≈ 11.5 mm，远大于挠度，故一端浮动支承 + 位置闭环做温度补偿。
pois.physics_en: Low gravity helps and thermal strain hurts. The same section carries only 38% of its Earth self-weight here, so stiffness margin is naturally 2.6x larger. What actually eats the accuracy budget is the 80 K day-night swing: a 12 m steel beam moves alpha x L x delta_T = about 11.5 mm, far more than any deflection. Hence one floating support and closed-loop position compensation against temperature.

pois.label: 供料系统（料仓+封闭输送）
pois.detail: 四腿锥底料仓储存预拌 regolith 干料，底部振动给料器破拱喂入全封闭斜置输送机，提升约 7 m 至塔顶中转箱，再经软管沿横梁送入打印头缓存斗。仓侧设检修爬梯。
pois.detail_en: A four-legged conical silo stores pre-mixed dry regolith. A vibrating feeder at the bottom breaks arching and meters into a fully enclosed inclined conveyor, which lifts about 7 m to a transfer box on the tower top; a flexible hose then runs along the beam into the print head's buffer hopper. An access ladder climbs the silo side.

specs.输送: 全封闭斜置输送机，提升 ≈7 m
specs.末端: 中转箱 + Ø100 mm 软管

specs_en.Conveyor: fully enclosed, inclined, about 7 m lift

pois.sim: 供料平衡：作业期用料 75 kg/h ≈ 600 kg/sol，输送机按 1.3× 裕度取 100 kg/h 即绰绰有余；满仓 26 t 够 43 sol 作业，矿场（res-mine-01）一个建造季来两三趟就行——供料从来不是瓶颈，能量才是。
pois.sim_en: Feed balance: the working draw is 75 kg/h, or 600 kg/sol, so a conveyor rated 100 kg/h already carries 1.3x margin. A full 26 t silo covers 43 sol of work, so the mine (res-mine-01) need only call two or three times a construction season. Feedstock was never the bottleneck here - energy is.
pois.physics: 全封闭输送在火星是必需而非选配：6 mbar 低压下细粉易带静电、逸散后吸附光伏板与散热面难以清除；0.38g 下颗粒料更易在锥仓内架桥成拱——所以锥角加陡并加振动给料强制破拱。
pois.physics_en: Full enclosure is mandatory on Mars rather than optional: at 6 mbar the fine powder charges electrostatically and, once it escapes, clings to photovoltaic panels and radiator faces where it is very hard to remove. At 0.38 g granular material also bridges more easily inside a conical silo, so the cone angle is steepened and a vibrating feeder forces the arch to collapse.

pois.label: 操作控制站
pois.detail: 现场 PLC 控制柜：HMI 主屏显示打印进度与传感器状态，副屏看路径规划，控制台上急停蘑菇头（戴加压手套可拍）与启动/模式按钮，底部黑黄警示带，侧面散热百叶，桅杆信标灯与无线回传天线。旁边电源撬块经地面电缆导管为全场供电。
pois.detail_en: The field PLC cabinet: the main HMI shows print progress and sensor status, the secondary screen shows path planning, and the console carries a mushroom E-stop (hittable with a pressurised glove) plus start and mode buttons. Black-yellow hazard banding runs along the base, cooling louvres sit on the side, and a mast carries the beacon and the wireless telemetry antenna. A power skid beside it feeds the whole site through ground cable conduits.

specs.控制: PLC + 工业 HMI 双屏
specs.安全: 急停回路 + 区域监控
specs.闭环分层: 路径插补 10 ms / 伺服环 1 ms / 流量环 100 ms
specs.运行模式: 常态舱内遥操作，现场站用于调试与应急

specs_en.Loop rates: path interpolation 10 ms / servo loop 1 ms / flow loop 100 ms
specs_en.Operating mode: normally teleoperated from inside; the field station is for commissioning and emergencies

pois.sim: 全程账：37 层约 100 sol 的断续作业里（每日随日照开停机），控制器同时闭环 3 轴位置 + 挤出量 + 微波功率 + 料位/压力/温度多路传感，任一越限先降速后停机（喷嘴回抽防滴料）；每日收工前必须走完当前层收口，免得冷接缝落在层中央。
pois.sim_en: Whole-run ledger: across the roughly 100 sol of intermittent work that built 37 layers - starting and stopping with the sun each day - the controller closes three position axes plus extrusion rate and microwave power, while watching level, pressure and temperature channels. Any limit exceedance slows the machine first and then stops it, retracting the nozzle to prevent drooling. Each day must end on a completed layer close-out, so no cold joint lands mid-course.
pois.physics: 为什么户外还留操作面板：火星常态是舱内遥操作，但工程逻辑要求在设备旁保留最短路径的人工介入点——大尺寸按钮与高对比界面按 EVA 手套人机工效设计。
pois.physics_en: Why keep an outdoor panel at all: the Mars norm is teleoperation from inside, but engineering logic demands a shortest-path point of manual intervention right at the machine. The oversized buttons and high-contrast interface are sized by EVA-glove ergonomics.

pois.label: regolith 装载机器人
pois.detail: 小型四轮铲装机器人，白黄涂装覆火星尘膜，前置铲刀、桅杆天线与传感头，停驻平台角落。负责场内清理与日常补料。
pois.detail_en: A small four-wheeled loading robot in white and yellow livery under a film of Mars dust, with a front blade, mast antenna and sensor head, parked in the corner of the pad. It handles site clearing and the routine silo top-ups.
pois.sim: 运力账：打印用料 600 kg/sol ÷ 单斗 0.44 t ≈ 1.4 斗/sol——一台小装载机就足以喂饱打印机，故本机是常规供料通道；矿场（res-mine-01）批量转运只管补满料仓，以及运送根本不需烧结的防辐射堆料。
pois.sim_en: Haulage ledger: 600 kg/sol of feedstock against 0.44 t per bucket is about 1.4 buckets a sol - one small loader is entirely enough to keep the printer fed, so this machine is the routine supply line. Bulk haulage from the mine (res-mine-01) only refills the silo and delivers the radiation-shielding fill, which needs no sintering at all.
pois.physics: 0.38g 下同功率铲装反力更小但轮地附着也降——牵引力上限 μ·m·g 同比缩水，故宁可小斗多趟、车身压重靠电池包下置。
pois.physics_en: At 0.38 g the reaction forces on a given digging power are lower, but wheel-ground traction falls in the same proportion: the traction ceiling mu x m x g shrinks equally. Small bucket and more trips is therefore the right trade, with the battery pack mounted low to add ballast.

pois.label: 电源撬块与日间作业制
pois.label_en: Power skid and daytime duty cycle
pois.detail: 带通风格栅的现场电源撬块，经地面电缆导管把电送到轨道旁接线箱与操作站。这台机器不接夜间基荷：微波烧结是间歇性大负载，按选型只在日间开机，峰值 30 kWe 由日间太阳能承担，入夜整机停机、仅保温待命——为它扩裂变堆阵不划算（EQUIPMENT.md §5/§7）。
pois.detail_en: The site power skid, vented and cabled through ground conduit to the trackside junction box and the operator station. This machine draws nothing at night: microwave sintering is a large intermittent load, so by selection it runs in daylight only, its 30 kWe peak carried by the daytime solar array, and shuts down after dusk on keep-warm standby. Expanding the fission baseload for it does not pay (EQUIPMENT.md sections 5 and 7).

specs.供电: 日间太阳能阵；基荷 6×Kilopower 不为其扩容
specs.建造任务: 单穹顶壳体 ~120 t / 一个建造季 ~200 sol

specs_en.Supply: daytime solar array; the 6x Kilopower baseload is not expanded for it
specs_en.Build task: one dome shell about 120 t in one construction season, about 200 sol

sim: 能量账：120 t ÷（200 sol × 日照 8 h）= 作业期 75 kg/h；30 kWe ÷ 75 kg/h = 0.40 kWh/kg = 1.44 MJ/kg 的能量预算。折回全天平均即 24 kg/h，与选型书的 ~25 kg/h 对上——25 是昼夜平均速率，75 是开机时的真实打印速率，作业占空比 32%。
效率反推：regolith 从 210 K 升到 ~1350 K 烧结温度需显热 cp·ΔT ≈ 0.8 × 1140 ≈ 0.91 MJ/kg；对 1.44 MJ/kg 预算即要求电→料端到端效率 ≥ 63%（磁控管 ~70% × 微波耦合 ~90%）。这条效率线正是选微波、否掉聚光熔融的定量理由——耦合效率一旦掉到 60% 以下，30 kWe 就买不起一个建造季。
sim_en: Energy ledger: 120 t / (200 sol x 8 h of daylight) = 75 kg/h while working; 30 kWe / 75 kg/h = 0.40 kWh/kg = 1.44 MJ/kg of budget. Averaged over the whole sol that is 24 kg/h, matching the ~25 kg/h in the selection brief - 25 is the round-the-clock average, 75 is the real printing rate while the machine is on, at a 32% duty cycle.

Efficiency implied: heating regolith from 210 K to a sintering temperature near 1350 K costs sensible heat cp x delta_T = 0.8 x 1140 = about 0.91 MJ/kg. Against a 1.44 MJ/kg budget that demands 63% end-to-end electrical-to-material efficiency (magnetron about 70% x microwave coupling about 90%). That efficiency line is the quantitative reason microwave was chosen over concentrated-solar melting: let coupling fall below 60% and 30 kWe can no longer buy one construction season.
pois.physics: 烧结而不熔融：只把颗粒加热到接触点原子扩散长出烧结颈，省掉整包熔化潜热（~0.4 MJ/kg，约占预算三成）。富铁 regolith 对 2.45 GHz 是体加热——微波从内部把整段料加热，而激光/聚光只加热表层，稀薄大气又不能靠对流把热铺开。低功率预算下这是唯一闭得上的加热路线。
pois.physics_en: Sinter, do not melt: heat the grains only until atoms diffuse across their contact points and form necks, and the full latent heat of fusion (about 0.4 MJ/kg, near a third of the budget) is never spent. Iron-rich regolith also couples volumetrically to 2.45 GHz - the microwave heats the whole charge from within, whereas a laser or concentrated sunlight heats only a surface, and the thin atmosphere cannot spread that heat by convection. On this power budget it is the only heating route that closes.
